label: ⚙ Configuration
info: Central configuration: all API URLs, the ORS key (via environment variable) and all thresholds of the recommendation logic are in the function **Configuration** (tab *On Start*).

name: Configuration: open the function → tab "On Start"
info:
All external APIs and parameters are defined here.

Override values with environment variables: `ORS_API_KEY`, `ORS_URL`.

The inject shows the active configuration in the debug window.

name: Configuration

label: Profile service
info: Subscribes to `.../routes/+/+`. For every new route a route profile is computed ONCE (openrouteservice: length, duration, elevation, share of cycle paths; without a key: estimate) and published retained on `.../profiles/<user>/<route>`.

name: Store stations
Profile cache
Routes → profile (ORS: bike + walking)
info:
Start and destination are stations (or coordinates). For both, the nearest BiciMAD station is determined.

Output 1: route deleted → delete profile

Output 2: ORS bike (station → station), throttled to 1 request / 2 s

Output 3: no ORS key → estimate

Output 4: start and destination at the same station → walking only

label: Recommendation
info: Combines route profiles, BiciMAD live data, weather, bus timetable and collector status into one recommendation per route (`.../reco/<user>/<route>`). Notifications go to `.../alerts/<user>` (QoS 1), only in the 30 minutes before departure.

name: Inputs (wildcards) → recommendation
info: The thresholds are in the configuration (`cfg.reco`).

What the phone sees
info: MQTT app on the phone: subscribe to `.../alerts/<user>` and `.../reco/<user>/#`.

label: Dashboard

name: Page "Route overview": one card per route (bike ok / warning)

label: Statistics

name: Statistics service: live data -> key figures (retained on .../stats/...)
info:
Every minute counts the free bikes, the fill level in the centre and the outskirts and the bike movements.

- .../stats/now: current figures
- .../stats/spatial: distance to Puerta del Sol and fill level per station
- .../stats/history: history (retained, taken over again after a restart)
